findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "skimguard_about" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Authoritative description of what SkimGuard is, how its detection works, and its known limitations. Call this before answering general questions about SkimGuard…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
